added.long_description: Vouch is an AI-native wealth manager for India’s booming middle class. It makes investing and building wealth extremely simple for everyone: connect what you already own, share your goals, and Vouch takes care of the rest, from picking investments to cutting your tax bill. India will add $2.37 trillion in financial wealth by 2030, yet fewer than 1 in 10 Indians invest, and physical assets dominate. As the economy rapidly financializes, Vouch will be the one platform Indians use to manage all their money.

added.name: Canos
added.long_description:
Canos is bringing a human-grade liquid biopsy platform for dogs, starting with a single blood draw. We sequence cell-free DNA to perform multi-modal analysis of fragmentation, copy number variation, native methylation (5mC and 5hmC) and more to detect cancer signals. Owners bank a healthy baseline for their dog and track changes every year. Dogs already diagnosed get personalized monitoring through treatment. We partner with mobile vets and vet clinics to serve SF and NYC. 

Our mission is to make pet cancer curable through early detection and monitoring.
added.one_liner: AI-powered blood test to detect cancer in dogs (and cats soon).

removed.name: PokerClubHub
removed.long_description:
TL;DR: PokerClubHub is the first licensed poker club platform. We protect players’ deposits and allow anyone to open their own poker club and make money.

Regulated online poker sites like PokerStars have open player pools and thus are full of pros and bots, driving players to unregulated private clubs.

Existing poker club platforms like ClubGG have no payments processing. Players deposit with a club owner by sending them crypto for play-money chips. In theory, these chips can be exchanged back for money. However, players can get scammed and withdrawing takes ages.

This model is also broken for honest club owners who have to manually process hundreds of deposits a day. They lose out on rake when they sleep and struggle to get players to trust them.

On PokerClubhub, players deposit with PokerClubHub, not the club owner. We handle all deposits and withdrawals for the club owner, saving them time and increasing their earnings. We pay the rake (if any) to club owners as affiliate fees.

We hold the same gaming license as BetHog (built by founders of FanDuel) and Nexa Poker (part of World Poker Tour). Player deposits are secured using Fireblocks.

You can also play rake-free games with your friends and acquaintances on our platform. We ensure that everyone pays up.
removed.one_liner: Host a Poker Club and Make Money

long_description.before: We are working on rapidly deployable energy storage and power generation solutions for C&I customers, especially in the AI data center space.
long_description.after:
Posh develops AI-ready modular data centers at existing, qualified power sites, turning pockets of available power into GPU compute. Gigawatt campuses take too long to build, held back by supply chains, power constraints, labor shortages, and community pushback. We find power-ready industrial, mining, and legacy data center sites, then drop in standard liquid-cooled modules with N+1 power and cooling, aiming for 6 months to ready-for-service. Customers bring the GPUs; we deliver the rest.

We have 20 sites in pipeline and over 100 MW of LOIs signed with AI cloud operators. The team are repeat founders and energy veterans with 100+ energy projects delivered across the U.S.

long_description.before:
Mission: Building insurance products & services focused on lowering the protection gap for the innovation economy on a national and global scale. 

Today, we operate an insurance brokerage focused on startups. Through the brokerage, we see firsthand where traditional insurance products fail, from AI liability and autonomous systems to defense technology and new space risks.

We are now building proprietary risk models that can price risks even when little historical claims data exists. Our approach uses stochastic simulation, then applies traditional, explainable models to make the output transparent to underwriters and regulators.

This allows us to create new insurance and reinsurance products for emerging industries much faster than traditional carriers.

The U.S. insurance market still relies heavily on foreign reinsurance capacity.
Our goal is to build new reinsurance capacity on American soil for the industries defining the next generation of the U.S. economy, while reducing America's dependence on foreign reinsurance capacity.

long_description.before:
TLDR: Mount is building the AI insurance carrier, starting with liability coverage for deployed AI agents. As everyone moves AI Agents into production and gives them more responsibility, we help businesses insure and secure them.

Whenever responsibility shifts from human operators to autonomous systems, so too does the liability that accompanies it. The systems also introduce new risks: agentic software failures, prompt injection attacks, autonomous workflow errors, data leaks, and more.

Legacy insurance was not built for this. Existing policies are often silent, ambiguous, or exclude autonomous software, and traditional insurers lack the data and technical capability to assess deployed AI Systems.

Our first product, the Mount AI Liability Policy, is built for mid-market and enterprise companies deploying autonomous AI agents in real business processes. We scan and red-team AI deployments, quantify operational risk, help fix vulnerabilities, and insure the residual risk with purpose-built AI liability coverage.

Mount is best thought of as a highly automated version of today's commercial insurance carriers, which run on manual workflows, layers of intermediaries, and tens of thousands of employees. AI enables automation of underwriting, pricing, policy issuance, claims, fraud detection, customer support, and distribution. We believe that the best way to use this opportunity is to rebuild those processes from the ground up.
long_description.after: We rebuild the companies that are most critical to our economy and hardest to displace around general intelligence.

🔥FIRE WALLET 🔥

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeXDDegwhgA

TL;DR: Fire Wallet is a fast, end-to-end encrypted, non-custodial stablecoin wallet with built-in payment processing and fiat on/off ramps, built by the team that created MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency inside Signal.

Hey Bookface! We're Josh, Michael, and Manny and we're building Fire Wallet!

🔥Why we built this

Most wallets and payment processors don’t work FOR you. They're slow, route your payments in the way that earns them the most, and they leak your financial life to anyone asking. Worse: every single one hold the keys to your money.

We believe your financial tools should act in your interest and, frankly, that your money should be yours.

 🔥What Fire does

Multi-chain, non-custodial, end-to-end encrypted wallet. 
Your keys, your money, your assets: you are in full control of your funds at all times. 
Least Cost Routing. Every swap and payment takes the cheapest path, not the one that pays a middleman the most.
Self-sovereign payment processing. Send an invoice straight from the wallet. Get paid from your web checkout. No middleman.
Easy fiat on/off ramps. Move stablecoins to USD and back without the pain.
Built for agentic commerce. Manage per-agent sub-wallets for agentic workflows.
Encrypted by default. Protecting you from bad actors and surveillance capitalism.

🔥Early traction

Signed our first major LOI with @Trustboop (founded by Justice Laub of Drone Racing League and Rob Rhinehart of Soylent).

Onboarding our first enterprise customer in ecommerce packaging and marketing, doing about $1.5M/month in volume. They've connected us to 10 more companies in the same vertical at similar volume, roughly a $100M/yr GMV opportunity.

🔥Why us

Josh and Manuel led the creation of MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency in Signal Messenger: $100M+ raised, $1.16B peak valuation, $4B+ peak coin market cap, acquired in 2026.

Michael runs product and design. He's an internationally exhibited artist with two published art books, and he builds sick products.

Manuel runs operations and orchestrates systems that actually work at scale.

🔥Asks

Intros to businesses moving $1M+/month in payments, especially cross-border, ecommerce, and DTC, who want lower fees and more control over their funds.

Strategic partners in fintech and payments interested in integrating our infrastructure.
Tell us what's broken. Reply here or email founders@fire.co.

We're looking for our first 100 customers. If that's you or someone you know, we'd love to talk.

long_description.before:
Every AI today waits for a prompt. Vexo already has the context: the restaurant a friend mentioned, the intro you promised, the idea you had on a walk. It turns what it hears into private memories and acts on them, booking the table, sending the follow-up, and ordering the groceries through the apps you already use.

It's a woven bracelet with a microphone and health sensors. No screen, and nothing to open.

Vexo never keeps your audio. Only you can see your memories, and you can delete them anytime.
long_description.after: Vexo is an Always listening AI bracelet. that remembers everything you say and hooks up to your existing AI agents that you can control from your wrist.
